title: Big Stretch White Caulking | GenStone
description: Big Stretch caulking is applied between panel connections and is elastic so it will not crack or break with any movements of the structure.

Big Stretch White Caulking

Home Finishes Big Stretch White Caulking
GenStone Big Stretch caulking is required for all exterior installations and recommended for interior projects. This caulking is applied along the shiplap edges of each panel and where panels connect to ledgers. Big Stretch caulking is elastic and will not crack if the structure moves which will help your seams stay tight and prevent any water penetration.
